36 weeks + 7 days = 36*7 + 7 = 259 days.  
1203 is not a leap year (divisible by 3 but not by 400 or 4? Actually 1203 mod 4 = 3, so not leap).  
From 07-03-1203 add 259 days:  
March has 31 days, so days left in March = 31 - 7 = 24 → add 24 days → March 31.  
259 - 24 = 235 days left.  
April (30) → 235 - 30 = 205  
May (31) → 205 - 31 = 174  
June (30) → 174 - 30 = 144  
July (31) → 144 - 31 = 113  
August (31) → 113 - 31 = 82  
September (30) → 82 - 30 = 52  
October (31) → 52 - 31 = 21  
November has 30 days, so 21 days into November = November 22.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1203-11-22
